prompt: Composition: Full-width relevant image with heading overlay, visible next section, no text/media split hero. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Work Sans; warm expressive serif with open functional sans. Use Spectrum 2-2: page #FBF9FA, text #2D1F25, accent #864E1D, secondary surface #E9EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 20px, heading 64px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
